result.conclusion: No global all-ticket correction survived prior-year calibration; MARKET_RAW remains the global quinella probability baseline.

interpretation: L1.75 is not useful as a blanket correction over every quinella ticket.
This does not invalidate previously observed horse-level market-dissent signal.
The remaining hypothesis is conditional use: apply/learn corrections only in disagreement regions rather than across the full ticket universe.
Do not optimize a hard STRONG tag or TopN rule yet; first test cross-fitted local residual models on predeclared dissent subsets.
next: L2_LOCAL_RESIDUAL_V1: keep MARKET_RAW globally; train/evaluate residual corrections only on tickets containing at least one horse with abs King-vs-market rank gap >=2, with >=4 as a separately reported diagnostic, and compare against unchanged market on the same subset. No test-year threshold tuning.
